none: PAS CAM-13F598: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. Mint is uncertain, AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding standard. Obverse shows pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.02g, diameter is 17.26mm
